DriveUpload.description:
The Game engine's `drive.result` payload plus `id` (= session_id).

Unknown top-level fields are allowed and kept in `raw_payload`. The car app forwards the
engine payload verbatim, so `session_id` and `user_id` may be present; if they are, they must
agree with `id` and `X-Driver-Id` respectively.
DriveUpload.title: DriveUpload

info.description:
Users, cars, drives, personal statistics and leaderboards.

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <access JWT>` for users; `Authorization: Car <car_token>` (+ `X-Driver-Id`) for the car app; `X-Provisioning-Key` for car registration.
info.title: Driving Score Platform API
